machine.note: Read 2026-11-08. Main haascnc.com VF-2 fetch returned no spec table; Haas Automation UK full specification and archived Haas sheet agree. Standard 8100 rpm configuration; model-year/options may differ.

vise.note: Kurt 2022 US catalogue p18, DX6 manual: B jaw width 6.000 in, H jaw height 1.735 in, AA maximum opening 9.080 in. Maker PDF indexed text read 2026-11-08; direct download returned 403. Inches converted exactly by 25.4.

clamp_force.note: Kurt DX6 manual, Manual Vise Clamping Force table, printed/PDF p4: 3440 lbf at 40 ft-lbf (10-80 ft-lbf rows: 512/1487/2464/3440/4415/5391/6367/7342 lbf). Operating Instructions p5 says supplied handle and correct torque provide the necessary clamping force; no extensions or impact tools. Planned 40 ft-lbf is step2cam judgement: moderate hand tightening, half the rated maximum 80 ft-lbf. Exact SI conversion: lbf=4.4482216152605 N, ft-lbf=1.3558179483314 Nm. Apply the planned torque and verify actual grip; no scaling by contact area.

holder.note: IMTE IMT100314 CAT40-ER32-3.0: gauge L 3 in =76.2 mm, D 50 mm, range .079-.787 in (nominal 2-20 mm). Maker HTML table downloaded 2026-11-08. holder_length models gauge projection; holder_diameter uses nut envelope. Correct collet and CAT40 pull stud must be fitted.

end_mills.note: Read 2026-11-09. Replace GA200 3309 with aluminium-specific single-flute 6793 D3/6/10/12/16 (catalogue p23: D/shank, OAL39/57/73/83/92, LOC12/20/25/30/35). Its own p23 slotting <=7% Si row: Vc300, fz D3/6/10/12/16=.019/.037/.065/.08/.10, one flute. No generic bright factor applied to this product-specific table. D20: standard RF100 A 3202 HA, four flutes, p15, OAL104, LOC38, shank20. Own speedfeed/3202.pdf p282 wrought <=3% Si (6061 included): slotting1625 SFM, D19.05 column IPT.0060, next smaller column. This chart has no bright factor; unlike the old 3309 p297 its values are for the named RF100 family. The 3309 bright factors were correct for that older family; not silently removed. Corner chamfer .45 mm on D20 is not represented by flat end_mill.

drills.note: Guhring 206 DIN338 jobber bright HSS, 118 degree, shank=cut diameter; l1 overall, l2 flute (not tmax). Al wrought <200 BHN:260 SFM; IPR .0020/.0065/.0100/.0125 at chart diameters 1.590/3.170/6.350/9.520 mm. Use next smaller chart diameter (conservative, no extrapolation), convert IPR x25.4. Starting data for 6061/6082; catalogue marks aluminium optimal. The shared 205/206 chart has NO wrought-aluminium recommendation for205: use the206 row only.

spot.note: Guhring 723 carbide uncoated 90 degree NC spot, EDP9007230100000: D10, OAL89, flute25, shank10. Al wrought <200 BHN:575 SFM (uncoated723;755 belongs to coated6027), use lower chart D9.520 feed .0125 IPR x25.4. Only spotting, not full-depth drilling.

spot120.note: Read 2026-11-13. Guhring 724 carbide uncoated 120 degree NC spot, EDP9007240100000: D10, l1 89, l2 25, shank=cut diameter 10. Spots the 118 degree 206 drills (process.spot_drill: spot angle at least the drill's). The 6028 sheet's 724 uncoated column marks aluminium optimal; the single 724 page marks it limited. speedfeed/724.pdf is the same chart as 723 (Carbide Series 546, 723, 724): Al wrought <200 BHN 575 SFM, lower chart D9.520 feed .0125 IPR x25.4. Only spotting, not full-depth drilling.

chamfer.note: TOYO uncoated TCM90-12:90 degree, shank/major D12, tip2.5, axial effective blade K4.75, seven flutes, OAL70. Aluminium Vc85-175 m/min, fz .015-.055 mm/tooth; use lower ends85 and .015. No D16 in this published family.

threads.note: Harvey 2026 catalogue p552, 8821xx single-form metric, uncoated. Individual -C3 product pages verify same geometry/axial LOC (links per tool). SF_882100 5x-neck chart: wrought 6xxx1000 SFM; use next smaller diameter column IPT, convert x25.4; four flutes. Use only listed coarse pitch per size (min=max); no unverified multi-pitch range. tooth_height is axial LOC, not radial tooth depth. neck_length conservatively uses full published max thread depth. Chart step3: internal feed correction (major diameter - cutter diameter)/major diameter is applied at the named nominal thread size; larger threads at the same pitch retain this conservative centerline feed.

engraver.note: Read 2026-11-09: Harvey30302 uncoated, 90 degree, 1 flute, shank/major D.125 in, tip flat .005 in, axial LOC.060 in, split length.375 in, OAL1.5 in. SF_25200 row30302 non-ferrous IPT.00176, 6000+ rpm, axial DOC<.010 in. Choose8100 rpm (step2cam judgement within chart), feed=8100*.00176*25.4*1=362.10 mm/min. Plunge50% per chart vertical-feed note; DOC.2 mm (step2cam judgement below .009 in).

taps.note: Dormer Pramet THREADING 2024 manufacturer catalogue, read 2026-11-09, p32 and p36. E559NO3(M) straight-flute bright HSS right-hand bottoming cut taps, explicitly suitable for machine use; form C 2-3 pitch lead, model worst case 3. THL is thread length, not usable length LU. p36 dimensions M3/M4/M5/M6: pitch .5/.7/.8/1, THL11/13/16/19, shank3.15/4/5/6 (M6 is6.00, not suggested6.3), OAL48/53/58/66 mm. Workpiece N1.3 hard-tempered wrought aluminium: starting Vc6 m/min, used as a conservative aluminium starting row rather than claiming exact6082 grade equivalence. RPM=floor(6000/(pi*major)), capped8100; synchronous feed is RPM*pitch, never a separate tap feed. Catalogue PDF is vendor-authored, hosted by a distributor because current maker product pages render only Loading. Haas rigid tapping must be enabled on the actual machine. Standard ER32 envelope retained; fit a compatible tapping collet/drive. Stickout=THL+5 mm is step2cam judgement.

_policy: Where the chart specifies Vc, RPM=min(8100,floor(1000*Vc/(pi*D))); imperial Vc=SFM*.3048. Feed=RPM*fz*flutes or RPM*feed/rev, rounded .01 mm/min; preserves chip load at capped RPM. End-mill plunge=25% lateral feed, stepdown=.5D, stepover=.4D: step2cam judgement, conservative engagement below sourced slotting depth, not vendor-specific recommended plunge. Stickout=LOC+5 mm for end mills/drills/spot; chamfer15 mm; thread max depth+5 mm; engraver12 mm: step2cam judgement assemblies with CAT40 ER32 76.2 mm projection / 50 mm nut from holder source. Thread policies and coolant remain as documented by family. Global allowances/clearances/tolerances are step2cam judgement. No parallels dimensions assumed.
_omitted: 6 mm ball end mill: no ball end type in resources/camlib adapter.
16 mm chamfer mill: no 16 mm cutter in sourced TOYO family; no verified matching geometry/cutting-data pair.

unknown_settings.note: These maker pages define setting meanings but do not specify installed values or verified defaults for this machine. Values intentionally omitted.

controller_settings._comment: Unknown: installed Settings 15/17/22/33/45/46/47/52, G92 shift, rotation/scaling option, highest tool identity (carousel vs SMTC and Setting 90), tool-change final gauge Z/location, acceleration and per-axis cutting limits, full collision geometry. Haas setting pages describe meanings but do not establish this machine's current values or verified factory defaults. Do not assume zero G92, mirrors OFF or Setting52=0 just to admit a post. See libraries/README.md.
